discipline: Each field is either {v: value, s: source_id(s)} where the value was read verbatim from that official source, or null with 'u' explaining why it could not be confirmed. Nothing is estimated, averaged or inferred.
amazon_price_policy: Amazon prices, availability and star ratings are intentionally NOT shown. Per S2 §2(b), prices/availability may only be displayed when Amazon serves the link or when obtained via Creators API/PA API; per S2 §3(t) customer reviews and star ratings may only be used when obtained via those APIs. This project holds neither, so those fields are blank and flagged.

products.name: TurboFry Touch 6 Qt. Dual-Basket / Dual-Window Air Fryer
products.asin_evidence: Following the supplied short link returned the Amazon detail page whose <title> reads: "CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black"

amazon_listing_title.v: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black

model_number.caveat: The owner's manual for RJ38-SQPF-3TDB-2W matches this listing's wording (dual baskets, easy-view windows, HI-FRY, Sync Finish). Amazon itself does not publish the model number on the ASIN, so the ASIN→model step remains a documented match rather than an official statement.

specs.label: Per-basket capacity
specs.note: The owner's manual states "two 3-quart baskets" outright, and the Amazon listing title says "2 Independent 3Qt". This upgrades the earlier blank row — the brand page only publishes the 6 Qt total.

specs.label: Hi-Fry maximum
specs.value: 450 °F / 235 °C, held for 2 minutes, for extra browning
specs.note: The manual is more precise than the product page: HI-FRY "Raises temperature to 450°F/235°C for 2 minutes". A buyer should read that as a finish mode, not a full-cycle 450 °F setting.

specs.label: Sync Finish
specs.value: Yes — delays the start of the shorter cook so both baskets finish together; a separate Sync Baskets function copies time and temperature to the second basket

specs.label: Basket coating / care
specs.value: Nonstick, dishwasher-safe baskets. Manual caution: never spray with aerosol cooking oil — use a non-aerosol mister instead

specs.label: Number of presets
specs.value: Four one-touch food presets: French fries, chicken, meat, fish
specs.note: The manual names the preset food types; it does not publish a default time/temperature chart for them.

brand_list_price.note: Chefman.com list price. The same page displayed several promotional prices on the access date; only the list price is recorded here because it is the stable figure.

pricing.amazon_price_reason: Not displayed by policy (S2 §2(b)); unavailable without Associates access.
pricing.msrp_confirmed: Not confirmed: the brand page shows a list price but does not label it as a manufacturer's suggested retail price. Chefman.com list price. The same page displayed several promotional prices on the access date; only the list price is recorded here because it is the stable figure.

brand_site_rating.note: Ratings collected by Chefman's own on-site review widget (4.6 average; 5★ 927 · 4★ 257 · 3★ 85 · 2★ 12 · 1★ 24). Read 1,302 reviews on 2026-11-13 and 1,305 on 2026-11-14 — the count moves daily, so it is stamped. Brand-hosted figure, not Amazon's.

commission.why_unverified: Amazon's published rate table (S3) lists rates by product category. It does not publish which category a given ASIN is assigned to, and air fryers are not named in the table. Choosing between the Kitchen row and the fallback row would be inference, so the rate is left blank.
commission.rate_source_note: Only S3 is authoritative. Several well-ranked third-party blogs claimed 3%, 4.5% or 5% for kitchen appliances on the same day; those were discarded as non-official and mutually contradictory.

competition.reason: Amazon does not publish these as stable, quotable facts, and scraping them into a published table would breach the aggregation restriction in S2 (IP License).

flags.issue: Two near-identical Chefman SKUs exist (RJ38-SQPF-3TDB-2 and RJ38-SQPF-3TDB-2W). The -2W owner's manual matches this listing's features exactly (dual baskets, easy-view windows, HI-FRY, Sync Finish), but Amazon does not publish the model number on the ASIN.
flags.action: Narrowed to a single documented match using the manufacturer's manual for -2W. Still flagged as a match rather than an official ASIN→model statement; confirm against the unit's rating label.

flags.issue: The Associates tag inside the link.amazon short link is not observable, so attribution cannot be confirmed.
flags.action: Flagged for the account holder to confirm in Associates Central → Manage Tracking IDs.
